instruction: A timber pagoda-style garden structure: a square platform with visible corner posts, two or three stacked layered roof tiers with upturned wide eaves, and restrained ornamental brackets. Natural timber, symmetrical.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a timber pagoda garden structure. A timber pagoda-style garden structure: a square platform with visible corner posts, two or three stacked layered roof tiers with upturned wide eaves, and restrained ornamental brackets. Natural timber, symmetrical. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
